notes: RED bug from W-M1-01 lane A fixed. Root cause: PawnSpriteBob sits on CHILD 'bobGo', but Awake did GetComponent<PawnMovement>() (PawnMovement is on ROOT -> null -> IsMoving always false -> walk-bob never fired, idle-only) and MirrorRootTint did GetComponent<SpriteRenderer>() (returned child's own bobSr, not the root tint anchor -> tint never mirrored). Fix: added explicit [SerializeField] movementSource (PawnMovement) + rootTintRenderer (SpriteRenderer); Awake uses movementSource (null-guarded), MirrorRootTint uses rootTintRenderer (null-guarded). No runtime GetComponent left on the child. SceneSetup wires both refs to ROOT components via the existing SerializedObject pattern. UNTOUCHED per contract: pawn size/scale, sortingOrder (10 body / 9 shadow), disabled-root-renderer tint-anchor design, all pathfinding wiring, authored amplitudes/frequencies, ease-to-zero-on-stop. Did NOT run Unity (QA verifies in batchmode). Component left on the child bobGo (cleanest: the child already owns the bobbed transform + body renderer); only the resolved refs point to root.
